items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Max was at my house a couple of years ago, he was in town doing a recording so I invited him over the house.

ctx.x: And with drums, I mean there’s some people like I say it’s like Elvin. Give me Elvin Jones, he’s like — he’s an old man, but he epitomizes like my era of drummers. Not that these kids aren’t playing — I don’t know if you know some of these guys like Billy Kilson and Billy Drummond and Gregory Hutchinson, these are these young kids that are demon drummers. And all of us, as soon as we listen to Elvin we have to go — and Max is another one. Still going. Max was at my house a couple of years ago, he was in town…
